Toss pasta with pumpkin sauce. Serve topped with crispy sage and parmesan.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
description: Simple weeknight chickpea curry with spinach and warming spices
instructions: Dice onion, mince garlic, grate ginger.
Sauté onion until golden. Add garlic, ginger and curry powder, cook 2 mins.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk. Simmer 12 mins.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Serve over rice.

name: Veggie Quesadillas
description: Crispy quesadillas loaded with beans, capsicum and melted cheese
instructions: Drain beans. Dice capsicum.
Mix beans, capsicum and corn.
Scatter bean mix and cheese over half of each tortilla. Fold.
Cook quesadillas in a dry pan 2–3 mins per side until golden.
Serve with sour cream, salsa and sliced avocado.

name: Tofu Pad Thai
description: Authentic-style pad thai with tofu, eggs and tamarind sauce
instructions: Soak noodles per packet. Press and cube tofu, fry until golden.
Mix tamarind, soy and sugar into a sauce.
Stir-fry tofu in hot wok. Push to sides, scramble eggs.
Add drained noodles and sauce, toss until coated.
Add bean sprouts, serve with peanuts, spring onion and lime.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Layers of crumbed eggplant, rich tomato sauce and melted cheese
instructions: Slice eggplant 5mm thick. Salt, rest 10 mins, rinse and dry.
Coat eggplant in egg then breadcrumbs. Shallow-fry until golden both sides.
Mix passata with garlic and basil.
Layer in baking dish: sauce, eggplant, cheese, repeat. Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 30 mins at 180°C until bubbling and golden.

name: Lentil Bolognese
description: Rich, meaty-textured lentil sauce over spaghetti — vegan comfort food
instructions: Dice all vegetables. Cook lentils per packet until tender, drain.
Sauté onion, carrot and celery 8 mins until soft. Add garlic.
Stir in tomato paste, cook 2 mins. Add crushed tomatoes and oregano.
Add lentils, simmer 15 mins. Season generously.
Cook spaghetti. Serve with bolognese sauce.

name: Mexican Black Bean Rice Bowl
description: Colourful vegan rice bowl with black beans, guacamole and salsa
instructions: Warm beans with cumin, salt and pepper.
Char corn in a dry pan.
Mash avocado with lime juice.
Divide rice into bowls. Top with beans, corn, tomatoes and guacamole.
Squeeze over lime, top with coriander and optional sour cream.

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
description: Fresh pasta tossed with tomato, mozzarella and basil — summer essential
instructions: Cook pasta al dente. Rinse under cold water to cool.
Halve tomatoes, tear mozzarella.
Toss pasta with oil, garlic, tomatoes and mozzarella.
Season well. Add basil leaves.
Drizzle with balsamic and serve at room temperature.

name: Vegetarian Chilli
description: Hearty three-bean chilli with corn and smoky paprika
instructions: Drain and rinse all beans. Dice onion, mince garlic.
Sauté onion until soft. Add garlic and spices, cook 2 mins.
Add tomatoes, beans and corn. Stir well.
Simmer 20 mins, stirring occasionally. Season well.
Serve with sour cream, cheese and corn chips.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
description: Creamy roasted pumpkin stirred through velvety risotto
instructions: Cube pumpkin, roast at 200°C 25 mins. Warm stock.
Sauté onion until soft. Add garlic and rice, stir 1 min. Add wine.
Add stock ladle by ladle, stirring constantly 20–25 mins.
Mash half the pumpkin, stir through risotto. Add remaining chunks.
Stir in butter and parmesan. Fry sage in butter, garnish on top.

name: French Onion Soup
description: Rich caramelised onion soup with gruyère toast on top
instructions: Thinly slice onions. Melt butter in a heavy pot.
Cook onions on medium-low 40 mins, stirring often, until deep golden and caramelised.
Add garlic, wine and thyme. Stir well.
Add stock, simmer 15 mins. Season.
Ladle into ovenproof bowls. Top with baguette slices and gruyère. Grill until bubbling.

name: Minestrone Soup
description: Classic Italian vegetable and bean soup with pasta
instructions: Dice all vegetables. Mince garlic.
Sauté onion, carrot and celery 5 mins. Add garlic.
Add tomatoes, stock and beans. Simmer 15 mins.
Add zucchini and pasta, cook 10 mins until pasta is tender.
Season, serve topped with parmesan.

name: Spanakopita
description: Flaky Greek pastry filled with spinach and feta — vegetarian classic
instructions: Squeeze all liquid from spinach. Mix with crumbled feta, eggs and nutmeg.
Sauté onion and garlic, add to spinach mix.
Brush a baking dish with oil. Layer 4 filo sheets, brushing each with oil.
Spread spinach filling evenly. Top with remaining filo sheets, brushed with oil.
Score top, bake at 180°C for 40 mins until golden and crispy.

name: Leek and Gruyère Tart
description: Buttery short-crust tart filled with sweet leeks and melted gruyère
instructions: Line a tart tin with pastry, chill 15 mins. Blind bake at 190°C 15 mins.
Slice leeks, sauté in butter until soft 10 mins. Season.
Whisk eggs, cream and thyme.
Spread mustard on pastry base. Add leeks and grated gruyère.
Pour egg mix over. Bake 25 mins until set and golden.

name: Roasted Vegetable Pasta
description: Baked seasonal vegetables tossed through pasta with herbs and parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cube all vegetables, toss with oil and garlic.
Roast 25 mins until golden and soft.
Cook pasta al dente.
Toss pasta with roasted vegetables, including any juices.
Serve topped with parmesan and fresh basil.

name: Bean and Vegetable Soup
description: Nourishing mix-bean soup with seasonal vegetables — batch-cook favourite
instructions: Dice vegetables, mince garlic. Drain and rinse beans.
Sauté onion, carrot and celery 5 mins.
Add garlic, cumin, stock and beans.
Simmer 20 mins. Add spinach, cook 2 mins.
Season well, serve with crusty bread.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-fry
description: Crispy tofu with colourful vegetables in a savory oyster-style sauce
instructions: Press tofu dry, cube. Pan-fry until golden all over. Set aside.
Chop all vegetables.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger 30 secs. Add vegetables, cook 4 mins.
Return tofu, add soy and hoisin. Toss to combine.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Cheese and Herb Omelette
description: Classic French-style omelette with gruyère and fresh herbs
instructions: Beat 2 eggs with a splash of milk and herbs per person.
Heat butter in a small pan over medium heat.
Pour in egg mix. Gently move with a spatula as edges set.
When nearly set, scatter grated gruyère over half. Fold over.
Slide onto plate. Repeat for remaining portions. Serve with salad.

name: Egg and Veggie Breakfast Burrito
description: Loaded morning burrito with scrambled eggs, beans and fresh salsa
instructions: Scramble eggs to your liking.
Warm beans, dice capsicum.
Warm tortillas. Layer with scrambled eggs, beans, capsicum and cheese.
Add avocado slices, salsa and sour cream.
Roll up tightly and serve.

name: Duck Breast with Orange Sauce
description: Pan-seared duck breast with a bright citrus pan sauce
instructions: Score duck skin. Season.
Start duck skin-side down in cold pan, render fat slowly 10 mins. Flip 3 mins. Rest.
Drain most fat. Add orange juice, honey, vinegar and stock.
Simmer 5 mins to make sauce.
Serve sliced duck with sauce, roast potatoes and green beans.

name: Prosciutto and Rocket Pizza
description: Thin-base pizza with prosciutto, rocket and parmesan — no cooking needed for toppings
instructions: Preheat oven to 230°C.
Spread sauce over bases. Scatter mozzarella.
Bake 10–12 mins until crispy and cheese is golden.
Remove from oven. Top with prosciutto and rocket.
Shave parmesan over, drizzle with balsamic. Slice and serve.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagels
description: Loaded bagels with smoked salmon, cream cheese and capers
instructions: Slice bagels and toast.
Spread cream cheese generously on each half.
Layer smoked salmon over cream cheese.
Top with thinly sliced red onion, cucumber, capers and dill.
Squeeze lemon over and serve.

name: Chicken and Prawn Pad Thai
description: Restaurant-style pad thai with both chicken and prawn
instructions: Soak noodles per packet. Slice chicken into strips.
Stir-fry chicken 3 mins, add prawns, cook until pink. Set aside.
Scramble eggs in wok. Add drained noodles and sauce.
Return protein. Add bean sprouts, toss through.
Serve topped with peanuts, spring onion and lime.

name: Aussie Mixed Grill
description: Classic barbecue plate with steak, sausage, chop and salad
instructions: Cook potato wedges at 220°C for 30 mins.
Heat BBQ or grill pan.
Cook steak to preference. Cook sausages 12 mins, turning. Cook chops 4 mins per side.
Grill bacon until crispy.
Serve mixed grill platter with wedges, coleslaw and tomato sauce.

name: Bibimbap
description: Korean rice bowl with vegetables, beef and gochujang sauce
instructions: Brown beef with soy and sesame oil. Separately sauté each vegetable with seasoning.
Blanch spinach, squeeze dry and season.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Divide rice into bowls. Arrange vegetables and beef in sections on top.
Place egg in centre. Serve with gochujang stirred in at table.

name: Japanese Chicken Ramen
description: Shoyu-style chicken ramen with soft egg and nori
instructions: Soft-boil eggs 7 mins, cool and peel.
Simmer chicken in stock 15 mins. Remove, slice thinly.
Season broth with soy and mirin.
Cook noodles per packet.
Assemble: noodles in bowls, ladle broth over, top with chicken, halved egg, nori and spring onion.

name: Vietnamese Chicken Pho
description: Fragrant star anise broth with rice noodles and poached chicken
instructions: Simmer stock with star anise and ginger 20 mins. Strain.
Poach chicken breast in the broth 15 mins. Remove and shred.
Season broth with fish sauce.
Soak noodles per packet.
Serve noodles in bowls topped with chicken and hot broth. Garnish with herbs, sprouts and lime.

name: Prawn and Avocado Salad
description: Light, fresh salad with juicy prawns and creamy avocado
instructions: Peel prawns if needed.
Slice avocado and cucumber. Halve tomatoes.
Whisk lemon juice, oil and mustard into a dressing.
Toss leaves with dressing.
Arrange salad on a plate, top with prawns, avocado, tomato and cucumber.

name: Tuna Melt Sandwich
description: Classic American tuna melt on sourdough with melted cheese
instructions: Drain tuna. Mix with mayo, mustard, diced celery and onion.
Spread tuna mix on 4 bread slices.
Top with cheddar slices.
Grill open-faced until cheese is melted and golden.
Top with remaining bread, slice and serve.

name: Club Sandwich
description: Triple-decker toasted sandwich packed with chicken, bacon and salad
instructions: Cook chicken and bacon. Slice chicken.
Toast bread slices.
Spread mayo on all slices.
Build first layer: bread, lettuce, tomato, bacon.
Add second bread slice, then chicken, cheese and avocado. Top and secure with toothpick. Cut into triangles.

name: Veal Scallopine
description: Thin veal escalopes in a rich lemon and white wine sauce
instructions: Pound veal very thin. Season and dust in flour.
Pan-fry in butter 1–2 mins per side until just golden.
Remove veal. Deglaze with wine, add lemon juice and capers.
Swirl in more butter to make sauce.
Serve veal with sauce and pasta or mash.

name: Seafood Fried Rice
description: Wok-fried rice with prawns, squid and egg in soy sauce
instructions: Heat wok over very high heat with oil.
Stir-fry seafood 2 mins until cooked. Set aside.
Add garlic and peas, cook 1 min. Push to side, scramble eggs.
Add rice, toss and fry 2 mins.
Return seafood, add sauces, toss to combine. Serve with spring onion.

name: Beef Yakitori Skewers
description: Japanese-style chargrilled beef skewers with a teriyaki glaze
instructions: Cube beef. Mix soy, mirin, sake and sugar into a marinade.
Thread beef and spring onion alternately onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry, brushing regularly with marinade, 8 mins total.
Rest 2 mins.
Serve over rice scattered with sesame seeds.

name: Salmon and Avocado Sushi Bowl
description: Deconstructed sushi bowl with sashimi salmon and avocado on rice
instructions: Cook sushi rice per packet, season with rice vinegar and sugar.
Slice salmon into thin pieces. Slice avocado and cucumber.
Snip nori into thin strips.
Divide rice into bowls.
Arrange salmon, avocado, cucumber and nori on top. Drizzle soy over. Finish with sesame seeds.

name: Turkish Chicken Kebabs
description: Marinated chicken thighs grilled on skewers with flatbread and salad
instructions: Mix yoghurt, garlic, paprika and cumin. Coat chicken thighs, marinate 30+ mins.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Grill 6–7 mins per side until slightly charred and cooked through.
Warm flatbread. Make a simple salad with tomato, cucumber and onion.
Serve kebabs with flatbread and salad.

name: Spanish Chicken and Chorizo Rice
description: One-pan saffron rice with chicken and chorizo — paella-style
instructions: Brown chicken thighs and chorizo. Set aside.
Sauté garlic and capsicum. Add saffron, paprika and rice, stir 1 min.
Add tomatoes and stock. Return chicken and chorizo on top.
Simmer without stirring 25–30 mins until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 mins, serve from the pan.

name: Beef Birria Tacos
description: Slow-braised Mexican beef in corn tacos with consommé for dipping
instructions: Toast and rehydrate chillies. Blend with tomatoes, garlic and cumin to a sauce.
Brown beef. Add sauce and 500ml water. Braise 2+ hrs until very tender.
Shred beef. Reserve braising liquid as consommé.
Dip tortillas in consommé, fill with beef and cheese, fold.
Pan-fry folded tacos until crispy. Serve with coriander and consommé for dipping.

name: Lamb and Eggplant Bake
description: Middle Eastern inspired lamb and eggplant bake with yoghurt topping
instructions: Slice eggplant, brush with oil, roast at 200°C 20 mins until golden.
Brown lamb with onion, garlic and spices. Add tomatoes, simmer 15 mins.
Layer eggplant and lamb sauce in a baking dish, ending with eggplant.
Spread yoghurt over top. Scatter pine nuts.
Bake 25 mins at 180°C until golden. Serve with rice or flatbread.

name: Tofu and Mushroom Ramen
description: Vegetarian Japanese ramen with miso broth, crispy tofu and soft egg
instructions: Soft-boil eggs 7 mins. Cube and pan-fry tofu until crispy. Slice mushrooms.
Bring stock to a simmer. Whisk in miso and soy sauce.
Add mushrooms and spinach to broth, cook 3 mins.
Cook noodles per packet.
Serve noodles in bowls with broth, tofu, halved eggs and sesame oil.

name: Warm Chickpea Salad Bowl
description: Hearty roasted chickpea salad with tahini dressing
instructions: Drain chickpeas, toss with oil and paprika. Roast at 200°C 20 mins until crispy.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic and water into a dressing.
Arrange greens, tomatoes and cucumber in bowls.
Top with hot roasted chickpeas.
Drizzle tahini dressing over and serve.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Pasta
description: Lean turkey meatballs in marinara sauce over spaghetti
instructions: Mix turkey mince, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic and oregano. Roll into meatballs.
Brown meatballs in oil 5 mins, turning.
Add passata, bring to a simmer, cover 20 mins.
Cook spaghetti per packet.
Serve meatballs in sauce over pasta with parmesan and basil.

name: Prawn and Corn Chowder
description: Creamy Australian-style chowder with sweet corn and plump prawns
instructions: Peel and devein prawns. Dice potato and onion.
Melt butter, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add potato and stock, simmer 12 mins until potato is cooked.
Add corn and cream, simmer 3 mins.
Add prawns, cook 3 mins until pink. Season. Serve with parsley and bread.

name: Mac and Cheese (Baked)
description: Creamy homemade macaroni and cheese, baked golden on top
instructions: Cook macaroni per packet, drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour to form roux.
Gradually add milk, stir until thickened.
Add 3/4 of cheese, mustard, season well.
Combine sauce with pasta in baking dish.
Top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake 180°C for 20 mins until golden.
kidFriendlyReason: mac and cheese: classic kid staple

name: Homemade Chicken Nuggets
description: Oven-baked crumbed chicken nuggets, crispy outside, juicy inside
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line tray with baking paper.
Cut chicken into nugget-sized pieces.
Set up crumbing station: flour, beaten egg, breadcrumb-parmesan mix.
Coat each piece in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs.
Place on tray, spray with oil.
Bake 20–22 mins, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with tomato sauce or aioli.

name: Honey Soy Chicken Drumsticks
description: Sticky, mild honey soy glazed drumsticks baked until caramelised
instructions: Mix soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, sesame oil and cornflour.
Pour over drumsticks in a baking dish, toss to coat.
Marinate 30 mins (or overnight in fridge).
Bake at 180°C for 45–50 mins, turning once, until sticky and cooked through.
Serve with steamed rice and corn.
kidFriendlyReason: honey soy chicken: mild, familiar sweet-savoury glaze

name: Homemade Sausage Rolls
description: Flaky pastry sausage rolls with beef and veggie filling, kid-tested favourite
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Grate carrot and zucchini. Finely dice onion.
Mix mince, grated veg, onion, sauces. Season.
Cut pastry sheets in half lengthways.
Spoon filling along one edge and roll up, sealing edge with egg wash.
Cut each roll into 4–5 pieces. Brush with egg.
Bake 25–30 mins until golden.
kidFriendlyReason: sausage roll: Aussie classic kid lunchbox staple

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: Classic shepherd's pie with beef mince and mashed potato topping
instructions: Peel and boil potatoes until tender. Mash with butter and milk.
Brown mince in pan, drain fat.
Add diced onion, carrot; cook 3 mins.
Add tomato paste, stock; simmer 10 mins. Add peas.
Transfer to baking dish. Top with mash and cheese.
Bake 180°C for 25 mins until golden.
kidFriendlyReason: shepherd's pie: familiar mince and mash, loved by kids

name: Toad in the Hole
description: Sausages baked in fluffy Yorkshire batter — a fun, hearty family dinner
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C with oil in baking dish inside.
Whisk flour, eggs, milk into smooth batter. Rest 15 mins.
Brown sausages briefly in pan.
Carefully remove hot dish from oven, add sausages.
Pour batter around sausages immediately.
Bake 25–30 mins until batter is puffed and golden. Do not open oven early.
Serve with gravy and veg.
kidFriendlyReason: toad in the hole: fun batter dish kids love

name: English Muffin Mini Pizzas
description: Quick mini pizzas on English muffin bases — kids can add their own toppings
instructions: Preheat grill to high.
Split muffins and lightly toast cut side.
Spread tomato paste, add toppings and cheese.
Grill 5–7 mins until cheese melts and bubbles.
Serve immediately.
kidFriendlyReason: mini pizza: interactive, familiar, easy to customise for kids

name: Cheesy Pizza Scrolls
description: Soft pull-apart scrolls with tomato, cheese and mild toppings — kids love these
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line tray with baking paper.
Mix flour and yoghurt to form soft dough. Knead briefly.
Roll out to rectangle on floured surface.
Spread tomato paste, scatter ham and cheese.
Roll up tightly. Cut into 8–10 rounds.
Place cut-side up on tray. Bake 20–25 mins until golden.
kidFriendlyReason: pizza scrolls: fun bake, minimal fuss, kid-favourite

name: Mince and Pasta Bake
description: Hearty tomato beef mince with pasta, baked under a golden cheese crust
instructions: Cook pasta until al dente. Drain.
Brown mince with onion and garlic.
Add tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, oregano. Simmer 10 mins.
Mix sauce through pasta. Pour into baking dish.
Top with cheese. Bake 180°C for 20 mins until golden.
kidFriendlyReason: pasta bake: cheesy, familiar, reliably kid-approved

name: Chicken and Sweet Corn Soup
description: Mild, silky chicken and sweet corn soup — warm, simple, loved by kids
instructions: Poach chicken in stock until cooked. Shred finely.
Return stock to pan, add creamed corn and corn kernels. Bring to simmer.
Mix cornflour with water, stir in to thicken.
Drizzle in beaten eggs while stirring to create egg ribbons.
Return chicken. Add sesame oil and soy. Adjust seasoning.
Serve with crusty bread.
kidFriendlyReason: chicken corn soup: mild, smooth, popular with kids

name: Baked Beans on Toast (Upgraded)
description: Upgraded baked beans with cheese and bacon on thick toast — easy weeknight win
instructions: Grill or pan-fry bacon until crispy.
Warm baked beans in saucepan.
Toast bread, butter generously.
Ladle beans over toast, top with cheese and bacon.
Grill briefly if desired until cheese melts.
kidFriendlyReason: baked beans: simple, filling, kids love it

name: Cheesy Scrambled Eggs on Toast
description: Creamy scrambled eggs loaded with cheese served on thick buttered toast
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Melt butter in non-stick pan over low heat.
Add egg mixture, fold gently with spatula as it sets.
Remove from heat while still slightly soft, fold in cheese.
Serve immediately on buttered toast.
kidFriendlyReason: scrambled eggs on toast: simple, protein-rich, universally liked by kids

name: Tomato Soup with Cheesy Toast
description: Smooth, sweet tomato soup served with melted cheese toast for dipping
instructions: Sauté diced onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add crushed tomatoes, stock and sugar. Simmer 15 mins.
Blend until smooth. Stir in cream. Season.
Toast bread, top with cheese, grill until melted.
Serve soup in bowls with cheesy toast on the side.
kidFriendlyReason: tomato soup: smooth, mild, beloved by kids

name: Crumbed Chicken Tenders
description: Golden crumbed chicken tenders — oven-baked, juicy inside and crispy outside
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line tray.
Slice chicken into thick strips.
Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumb-parmesan mix.
Arrange on tray, spray with oil.
Bake 20–22 mins, turning halfway, until crispy and cooked through.
Serve with coleslaw and tomato sauce.
kidFriendlyReason: crumbed chicken tenders: classic kid favourite format

name: Sausages with Mashed Potato and Gravy
description: Simple sausages with creamy mash and rich gravy — a weeknight classic
instructions: Boil peeled potato until tender. Mash with butter and milk.
Cook sausages in pan until browned all over.
Remove sausages. Sauté sliced onion in same pan.
Add flour, stir 1 min. Add stock, whisk until smooth gravy forms.
Serve sausages on mash, ladle gravy over.
kidFriendlyReason: sausages and mash: simple classic, universally liked by kids

name: Loaded Potato Skins
description: Crispy potato skins loaded with cheese, bacon and sour cream — a fun family share
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Bake whole potatoes 40 mins until tender.
Halve potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh.
Brush skins with oil, bake further 10 mins until crispy.
Grill bacon until crispy, crumble.
Fill skins with cheese and bacon. Grill until cheese melts.
Serve with sour cream and chives.
kidFriendlyReason: loaded potato skins: fun, cheesy, familiar kid-approved flavours

name: Beef and Vegetable Pasties
description: Flaky pastry filled with seasoned beef mince and veg — Aussie lunchbox icon
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Dice potato and carrot small. Sauté onion and mince until browned.
Add potato, carrot, peas, stock and Worcestershire. Simmer until thickened. Cool.
Cut pastry into circles using a side plate as guide.
Place filling on one half, fold over and crimp edges.
Brush with beaten egg. Bake 25–30 mins until golden.
kidFriendlyReason: beef pastie: Aussie classic, familiar pastry format kids enjoy

name: Spaghetti with Butter and Parmesan
description: Silky pasta tossed in butter and parmesan — the simplest kid-friendly dinner
instructions: Cook spaghetti per packet until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Melt butter in pan with garlic (optional, mild).
Toss drained pasta in butter.
Add pasta water a splash at a time to make silky sauce.
Remove from heat, toss through most of the parmesan.
Serve topped with remaining parmesan.
kidFriendlyReason: butter pasta: simplest possible kid dinner, always a hit

name: Potato Wedges with Dipping Sauce
description: Crispy oven wedges with homemade tomato dipping sauce — great Friday night treat
instructions: Preheat oven to 210°C.
Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, garlic powder and salt.
Spread on baking tray in single layer.
Bake 35–40 mins, turning once, until crispy and golden.
Serve with tomato sauce and sour cream for dipping.
kidFriendlyReason: potato wedges: simple, familiar, kids always enjoy dipping

name: Cheese and Vegemite Scrolls
description: Fluffy scrolls swirled with Vegemite and cheddar — an Aussie classic kids love
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Mix flour and yoghurt to form soft dough.
Roll out to a rectangle on floured surface.
Spread Vegemite thinly, scatter cheese generously.
Roll up tightly. Slice into 8–10 rounds.
Place cut-side up on lined tray. Bake 20–22 mins until golden.
kidFriendlyReason: vegemite cheese scrolls: iconic Aussie kid favourite

name: Ham and Cheese Toasties
description: Golden grilled ham and cheese toasted sandwiches — a quick, kid-proof dinner
instructions: Butter outside of each bread slice.
Optionally spread mustard on inside.
Layer ham and cheese between two slices, buttered sides out.
Cook in sandwich press or frying pan over medium heat.
Press down, cook 3–4 mins per side until golden and cheese melts.
Serve with salad or tomato soup.
kidFriendlyReason: ham and cheese toastie: effortless, universally loved by kids

name: Homemade Cheese and Tomato Pizza
description: Simple homemade pizza with tomato base and melted cheese — kids can help make it
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Spread tomato paste over bases. Season.
Scatter mozzarella generously.
Add any toppings (kids' choice).
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle oregano.
Bake 12–15 mins until cheese bubbles and base is crispy.
kidFriendlyReason: pizza: all-time kid favourite, interactive to make

name: Fish Fingers with Oven Chips
description: Crumbed white fish fingers with oven-baked chips — a classic kid tea
instructions: Preheat oven to 210°C. Toss potato chips in oil, bake 30–35 mins.
Cut fish into finger shapes.
Coat fish in flour, beaten egg, breadcrumbs.
Bake on separate tray 15–18 mins until golden.
Serve with chips and lemon wedges.
kidFriendlyReason: fish fingers: mild white fish, crumbed format kids love

name: Plain Beef Noodle Stir-fry
description: Simple beef and vegetable noodle stir-fry — mild sauce, no chilli
instructions: Prepare noodles per packet.
Brown mince in wok, add garlic.
Add sliced carrot and broccoli, stir-fry 3 mins.
Mix soy, oyster sauce, sesame oil and cornflour with water.
Add noodles and sauce, toss everything together until coated.
Serve immediately.
kidFriendlyReason: mild noodle stir-fry: familiar format, no spice, kid-approved

name: Baked Sausages with Roast Veg
description: Oven-baked sausages with roasted potato, carrot and zucchini — one-pan family dinner
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Chop veg into large chunks, toss with oil and garlic powder.
Arrange veg in baking dish. Nestle sausages among veg.
Bake 35–40 mins, turning once, until sausages are cooked and veg is golden.
kidFriendlyReason: baked sausages and veg: simple tray bake kids enjoy

name: Ham and Pineapple Mini Pizzas
description: Hawaiian-style mini pizzas on English muffins — kid classic with sweet pineapple
instructions: Preheat grill or oven to 200°C.
Split and lightly toast muffins.
Spread tomato paste over each half.
Top with ham, pineapple and mozzarella.
Grill or bake 8–10 mins until cheese melts and bubbles.
kidFriendlyReason: ham and pineapple pizza: classic kid-favourite Hawaiian combo

name: Cheese and Capsicum Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette filled with melted cheese and mild capsicum — quick protein-rich dinner
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper.
Dice capsicum finely.
Melt butter in non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour in egg mixture. As edges set, push them to centre.
When mostly set, scatter capsicum and cheese on one half.
Fold over and slide onto plate. Serve immediately.
kidFriendlyReason: omelette: mild, familiar egg dish kids enjoy

name: Savoury Bacon Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes topped with crispy bacon and maple syrup — fun weekend dinner
instructions: Whisk flour, milk and eggs into smooth batter. Rest 5 mins.
Grill or fry bacon until crispy.
Heat non-stick pan, butter lightly.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form, flip.
Serve pancakes topped with bacon and maple syrup.
kidFriendlyReason: pancakes with bacon: fun, familiar, kids love sweet-savoury combo

name: Chicken and Potato Bake
description: Simple one-pan chicken thighs baked with potato and rosemary — minimal effort, big flavour
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Cut potatoes into chunks, toss with oil, garlic and rosemary.
Arrange in baking dish. Nestle chicken thighs skin-up.
Squeeze lemon over. Season well.
Bake 45–50 mins until chicken skin is crispy and potato is golden.
kidFriendlyReason: chicken and potato bake: simple, familiar, mild one-pan winner

name: Beef Mince and Vegetable Pie
description: Hearty mince pie with veggie filling under a golden pastry lid — proper family comfort food
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Brown mince with onion, add carrot, tomato paste, stock and Worcestershire.
Simmer 15 mins until thick. Add peas. Cool.
Line pie dish with shortcrust pastry.
Fill with mince mixture. Top with puff pastry, crimp edges.
Brush with egg wash. Bake 30–35 mins until golden.
kidFriendlyReason: beef and veg pie: iconic Aussie comfort food kids love

name: Roast Pumpkin & Rice Salad
description: Golden roasted pumpkin with a rice and barley blend, peas and hazelnuts in a Moroccan maple dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C. Thinly slice pumpkin, arrange on a baking tray, drizzle with 1 tbs oil and season. Roast 20–25 minutes until golden and tender. Set aside to cool.
Place hazelnuts on a separate tray and bake for 8 minutes until golden. Cool then roughly chop.
Cook rice blend following packet directions. Transfer to a bowl to cool.
Cook sugar snap peas and frozen peas in boiling water for 2 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk maple syrup, white wine vinegar, Moroccan seasoning and remaining oil together. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine pumpkin, hazelnuts, rice blend and peas. Stir through the dressing and serve.

name: Sausage Ragù
description: Rich pork sausage meat simmered with tomatoes, red wine and herbs over pasta
instructions: Remove sausage meat from casings and crumble.
Fry onion and garlic in oil 3 mins. Add sausage meat and brown.
Pour in wine and cook 2 mins, then add tomatoes and fennel seeds.
Simmer 25 mins until thick. Season to taste.
Cook pasta per packet. Serve ragù over pasta with parmesan.

name: Apricot Chicken
description: Tender chicken pieces braised in a sweet-savoury apricot sauce — an Aussie classic
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C. Brown chicken in oil in an ovenproof dish.
Whisk apricot jam, onion soup mix and water together.
Pour sauce over chicken. Add sliced onion around chicken.
Cover and bake 40 mins, removing lid for last 10 mins to caramelise.
Serve with rice and steamed greens.

name: Vietnamese Caramel Pork
description: Tender pork belly in a sticky, sweet and salty Vietnamese-style caramel sauce
instructions: Cut pork belly into 3cm cubes.
Make caramel: melt sugar in a dry wok until amber. Add garlic and shallots.
Add pork and stir to coat in caramel.
Pour in fish sauce, coconut water and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Simmer 25–30 mins until sauce is thick and pork is tender.
Serve over steamed rice, garnished with spring onions.

name: Salisbury Steak with Gravy
description: Pan-fried beef patties simmered in rich mushroom and onion gravy — comfort food classic
instructions: Mix mince, breadcrumbs, egg and mustard. Shape into 4 oval patties.
Brown patties in a pan 3 mins per side. Set aside.
Sauté sliced mushrooms and onion in butter until golden.
Add stock, Worcestershire and cornflour mixed with cold water. Stir until thickened.
Return patties to pan, simmer 8 mins. Serve with mashed potato.

name: Creamy Pork and Apple Casserole
description: Pork shoulder braised with apple, cider and cream — a warming European-inspired one-pot
instructions: Brown pork in batches in oil. Remove and set aside.
Fry onion and garlic until soft. Add pork back.
Pour in cider and stock. Add thyme and mustard.
Cover and cook in oven at 160°C for 50 mins.
Core and slice apples, add to casserole and cook 15 mins more.
Stir in cream, adjust seasoning. Serve with mashed potato.

name: Ground Beef and Rice
description: Quick, budget-friendly spiced beef mince served over steamed rice with peas
instructions: Cook rice per packet instructions. Keep warm.
Brown mince with onion and garlic in oil, breaking up.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce and sesame oil. Stir well.
Add frozen peas, cook 2 mins. Serve over rice.

name: Beef Wellington
description: Beef eye fillet wrapped in mushroom duxelles and golden puff pastry — the ultimate centrepiece
instructions: Sear beef fillet on all sides in a hot pan. Cool, then brush with Dijon mustard.
Blitz mushrooms, shallots and garlic to a paste (duxelles). Cook in a pan until dry.
Lay prosciutto on cling film, spread duxelles, place beef at edge and roll tightly. Chill 30 mins.
Wrap in puff pastry, seal with egg wash and chill 15 mins.
Bake at 200°C for 25 mins for medium-rare. Rest 10 mins before slicing.

name: Osso Buco
description: Italian braised veal shanks with gremolata on creamy saffron risotto — a Milanese classic
instructions: Dust shanks in flour and brown in oil in a heavy casserole.
Sauté onion, celery, carrot and garlic until soft.
Add wine, reduce by half. Add tomatoes and stock.
Return shanks, cover and braise at 160°C for 2 hours until tender.
Make gremolata: mix lemon zest, parsley and garlic. Serve over saffron risotto topped with gremolata.

name: Pan-Seared Scallops with Garlic Butter
description: Golden-seared sea scallops with brown butter, garlic and lemon — elegant and quick
kidFriendlyReason: delicate texture not typical for children
instructions: Pat scallops completely dry. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a heavy pan until smoking. Add oil.
Sear scallops 90 seconds per side until golden. Remove.
Reduce heat, add butter and garlic. Cook until butter is nutty brown.
Add lemon juice and capers. Spoon over scallops. Garnish with parsley.

name: Creamy Garlic Prawns
description: Plump prawns in a rich garlic cream sauce — ready in 15 minutes, impressive every time
instructions: Melt butter in a large pan. Add garlic and chilli flakes, cook 1 min.
Add prawns and cook 1–2 mins per side until pink. Remove.
Add wine to pan, reduce by half. Add cream and simmer 3 mins.
Return prawns, add lemon juice and parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Pork Belly with Crispy Crackling
description: Slow-roasted pork belly with perfect crackling and rich pan jus — a show-stopping roast
kidFriendlyReason: crispy crackling is popular with kids
instructions: Score skin with sharp knife 1cm apart. Pat completely dry. Refrigerate uncovered overnight.
Rub salt generously over skin only. Let rest 30 mins.
Roast at 240°C for 30 mins for crackling, then reduce to 160°C.
Roast a further 2 hours until meat is very tender.
Rest 15 mins, carve and serve with apple sauce and roast vegetables.

name: Beef Bourguignon
description: Classic French braised beef with mushrooms, bacon lardons and red wine — slow-cooked perfection
instructions: Marinate beef in wine, thyme and bay leaves overnight.
Brown lardons and remove. Brown drained beef in batches.
Sauté garlic and onions. Add tomato paste.
Return beef, add marinade and stock. Bring to a boil.
Cover and braise in oven at 160°C for 2–2.5 hours.
Add mushrooms and pearl onions for last 30 mins. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Herb-Crusted Salmon
description: Oven-baked salmon fillets with a golden Dijon and herb breadcrumb crust
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Mix breadcrumbs, herbs, lemon zest, garlic and oil together.
Brush salmon with Dijon mustard. Press herb crust on top.
Bake 15–18 mins until crust is golden and fish flakes easily.
Serve with lemon wedges and salad.

name: Hidden Veg Bolognese
description: Classic bolognese with blended zucchini, carrot and spinach hidden in the sauce
kidFriendlyReason: kids love it — they can't see the veggies
instructions: Blitz zucchini, carrot and spinach in a food processor to a rough paste.
Brown mince with onion and garlic in oil.
Add blended vegetables and tomato paste, cook 2 mins.
Add crushed tomatoes, simmer 20 mins until thick.
Cook spaghetti per packet. Serve sauce over pasta with parmesan.

name: Rainbow Mini Pizzas
description: Fun mini English muffin pizzas with colourful vegetable toppings — kids build their own
kidFriendlyReason: interactive — kids love customising their own pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C. Split muffins and place on baking tray.
Spread tomato paste on each half. Scatter mozzarella.
Let kids add their favourite toppings.
Bake 10–12 mins until cheese is melted and golden.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Bites
description: Baked broccoli and cheese fritters — a great way to get kids eating greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Line baking tray with paper.
Steam broccoli until just tender, then chop very finely.
Mix broccoli, cheese, eggs, breadcrumbs, garlic powder and spring onion.
Form into small patties and place on tray.
Bake 18–20 mins until golden. Serve with tomato sauce.

name: San Choy Bow
description: Chinese-style pork mince in crunchy lettuce cups — light, fresh and fun to eat
instructions: Brown pork mince with garlic and ginger in oil.
Add diced water chestnuts. Cook 2 mins.
Add oyster sauce, soy sauce and sesame oil. Stir well.
Separate lettuce into cups. Spoon mince into cups.
Top with spring onions and serve immediately.

name: Sweetcorn Pancakes
description: Fluffy corn-studded savoury pancakes — great as a snack, lunch or side dish for kids
instructions: Whisk flour, milk and eggs into a batter.
Stir in corn, cheese and spring onion. Season well.
Heat a non-stick pan and melt butter.
Cook spoonfuls of batter 2–3 mins per side until golden.
Serve with sour cream and sweet chilli sauce.

name: Vegan Ramen
description: Rich miso-based broth with ramen noodles, tofu, corn and soft-boiled egg alternatives
instructions: Dice tofu and pan-fry in sesame oil until golden on all sides.
Simmer garlic and ginger in stock 5 mins. Whisk in miso and soy sauce.
Cook ramen per packet. Blanch bok choy in broth.
Divide noodles among bowls. Ladle broth over. Top with tofu, corn, bok choy, spring onions and nori.

name: Roasted Aubergine and Tomato Curry
description: Roasted eggplant and cherry tomatoes in a fragrant Indian-spiced curry base
instructions: Cube eggplant and toss with oil and salt. Roast at 200°C for 25 mins until golden.
Fry onion, garlic and spices 3 mins. Add tinned tomatoes and coconut milk.
Simmer 15 mins until sauce thickens.
Add roasted eggplant and cherry tomatoes. Simmer 5 mins.
Top with fresh coriander. Serve with basmati rice.

name: Vegan Jambalaya
description: Smoky spiced rice dish with beans, peppers, tomatoes and Cajun seasonings
instructions: Sauté onion, capsicum, celery and garlic in oil until soft.
Add spices and cook 1 min. Add tomatoes, rice and stock.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and cook 20 mins.
Stir in beans and heat through. Season and serve.

name: Middle Eastern Lentil Soup
description: Earthy red lentil soup with cumin, turmeric and lemon — warming and deeply satisfying
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add spices and cook 1 min.
Add rinsed lentils and stock. Bring to a boil.
Simmer 20 mins until lentils are completely soft. Blend half if desired.
Squeeze in lemon juice, season generously.
Serve with flatbread, topped with coriander and a drizzle of oil.

name: Vegan Mac and Cheese
description: Creamy dairy-free mac and cheese made with a cashew and nutritional yeast sauce
instructions: Soak cashews in boiling water 20 mins, then drain.
Blend cashews with oat milk, nutritional yeast, garlic, lemon, mustard, paprika and onion powder until smooth.
Cook pasta per packet.
Pour sauce into a pan and warm over medium heat until thickened.
Drain pasta and stir into sauce. Season to taste.

name: Roasted Cauliflower Curry
description: Golden roasted cauliflower florets in a rich coconut tomato curry sauce
instructions: Cut cauliflower into florets. Toss with oil and garam masala. Roast 200°C for 20 mins.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger until soft. Add cumin and remaining garam masala.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk. Simmer 15 mins.
Add roasted cauliflower and simmer 5 mins.
Cook rice per packet. Serve curry over rice.

name: Sweet Potato and Peanut Curry
description: Creamy West African-inspired curry with sweet potato, chickpeas and peanut butter
instructions: Peel and cube sweet potato. Fry onion, garlic and ginger 3 mins.
Add curry powder and cook 1 min. Add sweet potato and stir.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk and peanut butter. Stir to combine.
Simmer 20 mins until sweet potato is tender.
Add chickpeas, heat through. Serve with rice and coriander.

name: Coconut Squash Dhansak
description: Lentil and butternut pumpkin curry with warm Parsi-inspired spices and coconut
instructions: Fry onion and garlic 3 mins. Add spices and cook 1 min.
Add cubed pumpkin, rinsed lentils, stock and coconut milk.
Simmer 25 mins until lentils and pumpkin are very soft.
Stir in spinach and lemon juice. Season and serve with naan.

name: Baked Ziti
description: Hearty baked pasta with rich tomato sauce and three cheeses — Italian-American comfort food
instructions: Preheat oven to 190°C. Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes and basil, simmer 15 mins.
Mix ricotta with egg, half the parmesan and salt.
Layer in a baking dish: sauce, pasta, ricotta mixture, mozzarella. Repeat.
Top with remaining parmesan. Bake 30 mins until bubbling and golden.

name: Halloumi Curry
description: Golden fried halloumi in a fragrant tomato-based curry sauce with spinach
instructions: Slice halloumi and fry in a dry pan until golden on both sides. Set aside.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger in oil until soft.
Add cumin seeds and garam masala. Cook 1 min.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 mins. Stir in cream.
Add spinach and halloumi. Serve with basmati rice.

name: Haloumi Burgers
description: Grilled halloumi patties with roasted capsicum, avocado and herb mayo in a toasted bun
instructions: Slice halloumi 1cm thick. Grill or pan-fry 2 mins per side until golden.
Mix mayo with lemon juice and torn basil.
Toast burger buns. Spread herb mayo on bases.
Layer rocket, halloumi, roasted capsicum and sliced avocado.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

name: Thai Peanut Chicken Noodles
description: 15-minute stir-fried noodles with chicken in a creamy peanut and sweet chilli sauce
kidFriendlyReason: mild peanut noodles are a crowd-pleaser
instructions: Cook noodles per packet, reserve ¼ cup cooking water.
Slice chicken and stir-fry in oil until cooked.
Whisk peanut butter, sweet chilli, soy, lime juice and cooking water into a sauce.
Toss noodles, chicken, beansprouts and sauce together.
Serve topped with spring onions and roasted peanuts.

name: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken
description: Pan-seared chicken in a rich garlic, herb and cream sauce — on the table in 20 minutes
instructions: Season chicken and sear in oil 4–5 mins per side until golden. Remove.
Melt butter in same pan, fry garlic 1 min.
Add stock, cream and thyme. Simmer 3 mins.
Stir in parmesan. Return chicken and simmer 3 mins.
Serve with mashed potato or pasta.

name: Garlic Butter Basa Fillets
description: Tender basa fillets pan-fried in garlic butter and lemon — a quick budget-friendly dinner
instructions: Lightly coat fillets in flour. Season with salt and pepper.
Fry fillets in butter 3 mins per side until golden. Remove.
Add garlic to pan, cook 1 min. Add lemon juice and capers.
Spoon butter sauce over fish. Top with parsley. Serve with salad.

name: Air Fryer Pork Chops
description: Juicy, well-seasoned pork chops cooked in the air fryer in under 15 minutes
instructions: Mix spices, sugar and oil to a paste. Rub all over chops.
Preheat air fryer to 200°C.
Cook chops 8–10 mins, flipping halfway, until internal temp 63°C.
Rest 3 mins. Serve with lemon, chips and salad.

name: Quick Chicken Hummus Bowl
description: Spiced chicken strips served over creamy hummus with cucumber, tomato and flatbread
kidFriendlyReason: kids may not like hummus base
instructions: Slice chicken and toss with paprika, cumin and oil.
Pan-fry chicken 6–8 mins until cooked. Squeeze lemon over.
Warm flatbreads in the oven or dry pan.
Spread hummus over bowls. Top with chicken, diced cucumber and tomato.
Drizzle with oil and parsley. Serve with flatbread.

name: Sausage Pasta in Tomato Sauce
description: Sliced Italian-style sausages simmered in a quick, fragrant tomato sauce over pasta
kidFriendlyReason: sausage pasta is a family staple
instructions: Cook pasta per packet.
Remove sausage from casing and brown in oil, breaking up.
Add garlic, chilli and fennel seeds. Cook 1 min.
Add tomatoes, simmer 10 mins. Season.
Toss with drained pasta. Serve with parmesan and basil.

name: Spaghetti Puttanesca
description: Bold pantry pasta with olives, capers, anchovies and tomatoes — ready in 20 minutes
instructions: Cook spaghetti per packet. Reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Fry garlic, anchovies and chilli in oil until anchovies dissolve.
Add tomatoes, olives and capers. Simmer 10 mins.
Toss with pasta and a splash of pasta water.
Serve with parsley and crusty bread.

name: Smoky Chickpeas on Toast
description: Crispy spiced chickpeas on sourdough with Greek yoghurt and chilli oil — a 15-minute hero
kidFriendlyReason: spiced flavour may not suit kids
instructions: Drain and dry chickpeas. Fry in oil with garlic and spices until crispy, 8–10 mins.
Toast bread.
Spread yoghurt on toast. Top with chickpeas.
Drizzle with oil and squeeze of lemon. Scatter chilli flakes.

name: Red Lentil Dal
description: Simple tarka dal — red lentils simmered until silky with a tempering of spiced butter
kidFriendlyReason: mild version with minimal spice is kid-friendly
instructions: Rinse lentils. Simmer in stock with turmeric 20 mins until soft.
Heat butter in a small pan. Add cumin seeds until sizzling.
Add onion, garlic and ginger. Cook until golden.
Pour tarka over lentils. Add lemon juice and season.
Serve with basmati rice and coriander.

name: Cheeseburger Pasta
description: All the flavours of a cheeseburger in one creamy pasta dish — a family crowd-pleaser
instructions: Brown mince with onion and garlic. Drain fat.
Add tomatoes, stock, mustard and Worcestershire. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and stir. Cook uncovered 12 mins, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir through cheese until melted.
Top with sliced pickles and serve.

name: Garlic Butter Rice with Fried Egg
description: Golden crispy rice tossed in garlic butter, topped with a runny fried egg — pantry gold
instructions: Melt butter in a wok over high heat. Add garlic and cook 30 secs.
Add cold rice and press into the pan. Cook 3–4 mins until crispy on base.
Toss with soy sauce and sesame oil. Remove from heat.
Fry eggs in another pan to desired doneness.
Serve rice topped with fried egg and spring onions.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
description: Creamy chicken and vegetable filling under a golden puff pastry lid — freeze the extras
instructions: Dice chicken and brown in butter. Remove. Sauté vegetables until soft.
Add flour, cook 1 min. Gradually whisk in stock and cream.
Return chicken. Add peas and corn. Simmer until thick.
Transfer to pie dish. Top with pastry, seal edges, brush with egg wash.
Bake at 200°C for 25–30 mins until golden.

name: Spiced Lentil and Butternut Soup
description: Warming bulk soup with lentils, butternut pumpkin and warming spices — makes 8–10 serves
kidFriendlyReason: sweet and mild with warming spices
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add spices and cook 1 min.
Add peeled, diced pumpkin and rinsed lentils.
Pour in stock. Bring to a boil, simmer 30 mins.
Blend until smooth. Add lemon juice and season.
Freeze in portions. Reheat with a swirl of yoghurt.

name: Slow Cooker Pork Carnitas
description: Mexican pulled pork braised low and slow until tender — crisp under the grill to finish
kidFriendlyReason: pulled pork in tacos or rice bowls
instructions: Score pork and rub with cumin, oregano, paprika and salt.
Place in slow cooker with orange juice, lime juice, garlic, chipotle and onion.
Cook on low 8 hours until falling apart.
Remove pork, shred, then spread on baking tray.
Spoon over some cooking juices. Grill 5 mins until edges are crispy.
Serve in tacos with salsa, pickled onion and coriander.

name: Spinach and Pesto Gnocchi
description: Pillowy gnocchi tossed with jarred pesto and fresh spinach — ready in under 15 minutes
instructions: Cook gnocchi per packet. Reserve ¼ cup cooking water before draining.
Toss gnocchi with pesto, spinach and reserved water.
Add halved cherry tomatoes and heat through 1 min.
Serve topped with parmesan and toasted pine nuts.

name: Tomato and Ricotta Ravioli Traybake
description: Fresh ravioli baked in a vibrant cherry tomato sauce with basil and cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Mix passata, olive oil, garlic and dried basil in a large baking dish.
Add fresh ravioli and cherry tomatoes, toss gently.
Tear mozzarella over the top. Scatter parmesan.
Bake 20 mins until bubbling and golden. Top with fresh basil.

name: Hoisin Sausage Rice Bowl
description: Glazed cocktail sausages in hoisin sauce over steamed rice with quick-pickled cucumber
kidFriendlyReason: sticky sausages are a hit with kids
instructions: Cook rice per packet. Quickly pickle thinly sliced cucumber in vinegar with a pinch of sugar.
Brown sausages in a pan 5 mins. Add hoisin, soy and sesame oil.
Cook 3 mins until glazed.
Serve over rice with pickled cucumber, spring onions and sesame seeds.

name: Mediterranean Prawn and Rice Bake
description: One-pan baked rice with prawns, olives, sun-dried tomatoes and feta — minimal washing up
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Combine rice, stock, garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, oregano and oil in a baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake 20 mins.
Remove foil, add prawns, cherry tomatoes and olives. Bake 10 mins.
Crumble feta over top. Scatter parsley and serve from the dish.

name: Quick Bulgogi Rice Bowls
description: Korean-style marinated beef mince served over rice with sesame and spring onion
instructions: Cook rice. Mix soy, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, ginger and gochujang.
Brown beef mince in a wok over high heat.
Pour sauce over and cook 2 mins until caramelised.
Serve over rice with sliced cucumber, spring onions and sesame seeds.

name: Parmesan-Crusted Fish Fillets
description: Oven-baked fish fillets with a crispy parmesan and herb crust — fast and impressive
instructions: Preheat oven to 210°C. Line baking tray with paper.
Mix parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, lemon zest, parsley and oil.
Spread mayo over fish fillets. Press parmesan crust on top.
Bake 14–16 mins until crust is golden and fish flakes easily.
Serve with chips and salad.

name: Orange Teriyaki Pork with Noodles
description: Pork strips glazed in sweet orange teriyaki sauce over rice noodles with greens
kidFriendlyReason: sweet teriyaki glaze is popular with kids
instructions: Soak rice noodles in boiling water 5 mins, drain.
Stir-fry pork in oil over high heat 3–4 mins.
Mix teriyaki and orange juice. Add to pork with garlic. Cook 2 mins.
Add bok choy and noodles. Toss to combine.
Serve topped with sesame seeds and spring onions.

name: One-Tray Thai Green Fish Curry
description: Fish fillets, vegetables and coconut milk baked with Thai green curry paste in one tray
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Whisk coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce and lime juice.
Pour into a baking dish. Add broccolini, capsicum and kaffir lime leaves.
Nestle fish fillets in the sauce.
Bake 18–20 mins until fish is cooked. Scatter coriander. Serve with rice.

name: Air Fryer Sweet Chilli Chicken Tacos
description: Crispy air-fried chicken strips tossed in sweet chilli glaze, served in warm taco shells
instructions: Slice chicken into strips. Dip in egg, coat in breadcrumbs.
Air fry at 200°C for 12 mins until crispy. Toss in sweet chilli and soy.
Shred cabbage finely. Slice avocado.
Warm taco shells. Fill with cabbage, chicken and avocado.
Serve with sour cream and lime wedges.

name: Baked Honey Lime Salmon
description: Salmon fillets glazed with honey, lime and garlic — naturally gluten-free, 20-minute dinner
kidFriendlyReason: salmon texture not always popular with kids
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Mix honey, lime juice, garlic and tamari.
Place salmon on lined baking tray. Spoon glaze over each fillet.
Bake 12–14 mins until salmon is just cooked and glaze is sticky.
Garnish with coriander. Serve with steamed jasmine rice and greens.

name: Halloumi Skewers with Mint Yoghurt
description: Grilled halloumi and vegetable skewers with cooling mint and garlic yoghurt dip
instructions: Soak skewers if wooden. Cut halloumi and vegetables into 3cm pieces.
Thread alternately onto skewers. Brush with oil and oregano.
Grill or BBQ 4–5 mins per side until charred.
Mix yoghurt with mint, garlic and lemon juice.
Serve skewers with mint yoghurt, flatbread and salad.

name: Quinoa Roasted Veg Bowl
description: Protein-packed quinoa with roasted seasonal vegetables, feta and lemon dressing
kidFriendlyReason: quinoa texture often disliked by young kids
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cube vegetables and toss with oil. Roast 25 mins.
Cook quinoa per packet. Drain and fluff.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and honey for dressing.
Combine quinoa, roasted veg, chickpeas and rocket in a bowl.
Drizzle dressing over. Crumble feta on top.

name: BBQ Pulled Pork
description: Slow cooker pulled pork with smoky BBQ sauce — fork-tender after 8 hours. Pile into buns with coleslaw.
instructions: Mix brown sugar, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, mustard powder and salt into a dry rub.
Pat pork shoulder dry and rub all over with the spice mix.
Place pork in slow cooker. Pour apple cider vinegar and half the BBQ sauce around the pork.
Cook on LOW for 8 hours or HIGH for 5 hours until the meat pulls apart easily.
Remove pork and shred with two forks, discarding any large fat pieces.
Stir remaining BBQ sauce through the shredded pork. Add a splash of cooking juices to taste.
Serve in buns with coleslaw. Leftovers freeze well.

name: Slow Cooker Leg of Lamb
description: Fall-off-the-bone lamb leg slow cooked with garlic, rosemary and root vegetables. A proper Sunday roast with minimal effort.
instructions: Cut slits all over the lamb leg and push in garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs.
Season lamb generously with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large pan over high heat. Sear lamb on all sides until browned (about 5 mins).
Place roughly chopped onion, carrots and celery into slow cooker.
Mix stock, tomato paste and Worcestershire sauce and pour over vegetables.
Sit the seared lamb on top. Cook on LOW for 8-10 hours until completely tender.
Rest lamb 15 minutes before carving. Strain cooking juices to make a simple gravy.

name: Shredded Slow Cooker Chicken
description: Foolproof shredded chicken from the slow cooker — juicy, versatile and done in 3 hours. Use in tacos, sandwiches, salads or pasta.
instructions: Place chicken breasts in the bottom of the slow cooker in a single layer.
Mix all spices together and sprinkle over the chicken.
Pour chicken stock around (not over) the chicken.
Cook on LOW for 3-4 hours or HIGH for 1.5-2 hours. Do not overcook.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks.
Return shredded chicken to cooker and toss through the cooking juices.
Use immediately or refrigerate for up to 4 days. Freezes well.

name: Chinese Shredded Chicken
description: Slow cooker Chinese-style shredded chicken with soy, hoisin and five spice. Serve over rice with spring onion and sesame.
instructions: Mix soy sauce, hoisin, oyster sauce, five spice, ginger, garlic, sesame oil and brown sugar in the slow cooker.
Add chicken thighs and turn to coat in the sauce.
Cook on LOW for 4-5 hours or HIGH for 2.5-3 hours until very tender.
Remove chicken and shred finely with two forks.
Return chicken to the sauce. If sauce is thin, cook on HIGH with lid off for 15 mins.
Serve over steamed rice, topped with sliced spring onions and extra sesame oil.

name: Slow Cooker Pulled Beef
description: Meltingly tender pulled beef — deeply savoury with a hint of smokiness. Great in buns, tacos or on mash.
instructions: Pat beef dry and season with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder and onion powder.
Heat oil in a large pan over very high heat. Sear beef on all sides until deeply browned.
Place sliced onion and garlic in slow cooker base.
Sit seared beef on top. Mix stock, Worcestershire, brown sugar and tomato paste and pour over.
Cook on LOW for 8-10 hours until beef pulls apart with a fork.
Remove beef and shred. Skim fat from cooking liquid, then stir through shredded beef.
Serve in toasted buns, on mashed potato, or in tacos with pickled onion and slaw.

name: Shredded Beef Ragu Pasta
description: Slow cooker shredded beef ragu with crushed tomatoes and red wine — rich, deeply flavoured, better the next day.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan. Sear beef in batches over high heat until browned all over.
Finely dice onion, carrot and celery. Add to slow cooker.
Place seared beef on top. Add garlic, tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, wine, stock, bay leaves and oregano.
Cook on LOW for 8-10 hours until beef is very tender and falls apart.
Remove beef and shred coarsely with two forks. Discard bay leaves.
Return beef to the sauce and stir well. Season generously.
Cook pasta in salted boiling water. Toss with ragu and serve with parmesan.

name: Slow Cooker Pork Loin Roast
description: Juicy pork loin slow cooked with apple cider, garlic and fresh herbs. Slices beautifully and makes its own simple pan jus.
instructions: Season pork loin all over with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a pan over high heat. Sear pork on all sides until golden brown.
Spread Dijon mustard and brown sugar over the top of the pork.
Place sliced onion and carrots in slow cooker. Lay thyme and rosemary on top.
Sit pork on the vegetables. Mix apple cider and stock and pour around (not over) the pork.
Cook on LOW for 5-6 hours until internal temperature reaches 63°C (145°F).
Rest 10 minutes before slicing. Use cooking juices strained as a simple jus.

name: Pork Carnitas
description: Mexican slow cooker pulled pork — spiced, slow cooked then crisped under the grill. The best tacos you will make at home.
instructions: Mix cumin, oregano, paprika and salt into a dry rub. Coat pork shoulder all over.
Place sliced onion and garlic in slow cooker base.
Set pork on top. Mix orange juice, lime juice, chipotle and stock and pour around pork.
Cook on LOW for 8-10 hours or HIGH for 5 hours until pork shreds easily.
Remove pork and shred coarsely with two forks.
Spread shredded pork on a foil-lined tray. Spoon over a few tablespoons of cooking juices.
Grill/broil on HIGH for 5-7 minutes until edges crisp. Serve in warm tortillas.
